AgentTasks.Goal:
Implement a production-ready FIDO2/WebAuthn Relying Party Server in Rust with complete FIDO Alliance specification compliance. The server must support both registration (attestation) and authentication (assertion) flows using the **webauthn-rs** crate.
Core endpoints to implement: 1. `POST /webauthn/attestation/options` — initiate user registration 2. `POST /webauthn/attestation/result` — complete user registration 3. `POST /webauthn/assertion/options` — initiate user authentication 4. `POST /webauthn/assertion/result` — complete user authentication 5. `GET /webauthn/user/{user_id}/credentials` — list user credentials 6. `DELETE /webauthn/credential/{credential_id}` — remove credential
Security Requirements: - TLS 1.3 enforcement for all endpoints - Replay attack prevention with challenge expiration - Rate limiting and brute force protection - Secure credential storage with encryption at rest - Full FIDO2 Level 1 and Level 2 compliance
Execute tasks sequentially with validation at each step.
